youtube_short.title: 90% of Hospital Bills Are Negotiable — Most People Never Ask
title_alternatives: Your Hospital Bill Is an Opening Offer — Save $2,400
One Phone Call Gets $2,400 Off Your Medical Bill
youtube_short.description: That hospital bill sitting on your counter? It's not a final number — it's an opening offer. 80% of medical bills have at least one billing error averaging $1,300. 90% can be negotiated down. And hospitals are legally required to have charity care programs for anyone who asks. The average savings from negotiating is 30–40%, which on a $6,900 bill is $2,400 back in your pocket. All it takes is one call: 'Can I see the itemized bill? What can you do about the balance?' Follow for a fresh money insight every day. #hospitalBill #medicaldebt #moneytips #personalfinance #savemoney
